name: Confirmation Ladder
note: Base state S = close above EMA(20) with ADX(14) over 25 (mirrored for short). Enters only on the FIRST bar of an N-bar unbroken run of that state, so N=1 and N=3 trade disjoint populations rather than being a threshold tweak. Holding period H is swept independently of N via time_stop -- the N-by-H response surface is the deliverable, and tying the two together is the error the source paper names.
source: Moskowitz, Ooi & Pedersen (2012), 'Time Series Momentum', Journal of Financial Economics 104:228-250. Read directly from the published PDF; the argument that forcing lookback to equal holding period masks predictability is in the literature-review section.
